panels.description: 当前仍为 failed 的文档；使用本模块底部分页栏，每页50条；输入页码后按Enter跳转。重处理完成后自动剔除。space_name缺失时回退为space_id。

targets.rawSql: SELECT k.updated_at AS "失败时间", COALESCE(t.name, k.tenant_id::text) AS "账号/工作空间", COALESCE(ds.name, '手工/API上传') AS "数据源", COALESCE(NULLIF(k.metadata::jsonb->>'space_name',''), NULLIF(k.metadata::jsonb->>'space_id',''), '—') AS "空间", COALESCE(NULLIF(k.title,''), NULLIF(k.file_name,''), k.id) AS "文档", COALESCE(sp.name, 'knowledge_processing') AS "失败阶段", COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.error_code,''), 'UNKNOWN') AS "错误码", LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(sp.error_message,''), NULLIF(k.error_message,''), '未记录错误信息'), 600) AS "异常信息", k.id AS "knowledge_id", k.knowledge_base_id AS "knowledge_base_id", COALESCE(k.metadata::jsonb->>'datasource_id','') AS "data_source_id", COALESCE(k.metadata::jsonb->>'file_id', k.metadata::jsonb->>'external_id','') AS "源文档ID" FROM knowledges k LEFT JOIN tenants t ON t.id=k.tenant_id LEFT JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id=k.metadata::jsonb->>'datasource_id' LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT s.name,s.error_code,s.error_message FROM knowledge_processing_spans s WHERE s.knowledge_id=k.id AND s.status='failed' ORDER BY s.finished_at DESC NULLS LAST,s.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1) sp ON TRUE WHERE k.parse_status='failed' AND k.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY k.updated_at DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET (GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(${doc_page:sqlstring}, '')::int,1),1)-1)*50

panels.description: 每个数据源仅保留最新一次失败或部分成功；使用本模块底部分页栏，每页50条；输入页码后按Enter跳转。后续同步成功后自动剔除。

targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data_source_id) * FROM sync_logs ORDER BY data_source_id, updated_at DESC, id DESC) SELECT sl.updated_at AS "时间", COALESCE(t.name, sl.tenant_id::text) AS "账号/工作空间", ds.name AS "数据源", ds.type AS "类型", sl.status AS "状态", sl.items_total AS "总数", sl.items_failed AS "失败数", LEFT(COALESCE(NULLIF(sl.error_message,''), sl.result::text, '未记录错误信息'), 600) AS "异常信息", sl.id AS "sync_log_id", sl.data_source_id AS "data_source_id" FROM latest sl JOIN data_sources ds ON ds.id=sl.data_source_id LEFT JOIN tenants t ON t.id=sl.tenant_id WHERE sl.status IN ('failed','partial') ORDER BY sl.updated_at DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET (GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(${sync_page:sqlstring}, '')::int,1),1)-1)*50

panels.title: 未解决数据源同步异常

panels.description: 仅显示当前仍未解决的业务死信；同一任务类型和业务对象只保留最新一条。已完成或已删除对象的历史档案仍保留在数据库，但不占用本面板。

targets.rawSql: WITH latest_sync AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (data_source_id) data_source_id,status FROM sync_logs ORDER BY data_source_id,updated_at DESC,id DESC), unresolved AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (dl.task_type,COALESCE(NULLIF(dl.related_id,''),NULLIF(dl.payload->>'data_source_id',''),dl.id::text)) dl.*,COALESCE(NULLIF(dl.related_id,''),NULLIF(dl.payload->>'data_source_id',''),dl.id::text) AS business_id FROM task_dead_letters dl LEFT JOIN knowledges k ON k.id=dl.related_id AND k.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN latest_sync ls ON ls.data_source_id=dl.payload->>'data_source_id' WHERE (dl.task_type='datasource:sync' AND ls.status IN ('failed','partial')) OR (dl.task_type<>'datasource:sync' AND k.parse_status='failed') ORDER BY dl.task_type,COALESCE(NULLIF(dl.related_id,''),NULLIF(dl.payload->>'data_source_id',''),dl.id::text),dl.failed_at DESC,dl.id DESC) SELECT u.failed_at AS "失败时间",COALESCE(t.name,u.tenant_id::text) AS "账号/工作空间",u.task_type AS "任务类型",u.scope AS "范围",u.scope_id AS "范围ID",u.business_id AS "关联ID",u.fail_count AS "失败次数",LEFT(u.last_error,600) AS "异常信息" FROM unresolved u LEFT JOIN tenants t ON t.id=u.tenant_id ORDER BY u.failed_at DESC LIMIT 50 OFFSET (GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF(${dead_page:sqlstring}, '')::int,1),1)-1)*50
